purpose: Independent synthetic DEVELOPMENT capacity case: eight explicitly requested facets need eight short stored procedures. Not a held-out quality gate.

case.question: Summarize each saved greenhouse procedure: pump priming, door-hinge lubrication, roof-gutter clearing, thermostat calibration, tray cleaning, drain flushing, fan-guard cleaning, and vent-latch inspection.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: To prime the greenhouse circulation pump, switch it off, fill its priming chamber with clean water, close the chamber cap, and restart it. Check that water flows before leaving it running.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: Lubricate the greenhouse door hinges by wiping grit from each pin, adding one drop of light machine oil, and moving the door through its full travel. Wipe away excess oil.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: Clear the greenhouse roof gutter from a stable working platform. Remove leaves with a scoop, collect them in a bucket, and run a small amount of water through the downpipe to check flow.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: Check greenhouse thermostat calibration by placing a reference thermometer beside its sensor for thirty minutes. Record the difference and adjust the thermostat offset according to its manual.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: Clean empty greenhouse planting trays by brushing out dry soil, washing with warm soapy water, rinsing thoroughly, and leaving them to dry before storage. Inspect for cracks while washing.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: Flush the greenhouse floor drain by lifting the grate, removing visible debris, and pouring in a bucket of clean water. Refit the grate and confirm that no water remains pooled on the floor.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: Before cleaning a greenhouse fan guard, disconnect power and wait for the blades to stop. Remove dust from the guard with a soft brush and refit it securely before reconnecting power.

fields.name: highlightedText
fields.text: Inspect each greenhouse vent latch by opening and closing it by hand. Check that the catch fully engages, tighten loose mounting screws, and mark any bent latch for replacement.
